message: Last week, we had a power outage that lasted several hours, and of course, my friend Sam was in full-on panic mode. He was convinced we needed to gather supplies like we were heading into a zombie apocalypse. Meanwhile, I just pulled out my trusty flashlight and charged up my phone with a power bank. We ended up playing board games by lantern light, laughing more than worrying. It was a great reminder that a little preparation can turn a blackout into a cozy night in. Have you ever turned a hiccup into an unexpected adventure?
